source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of antivirus software (PDF 181).

blocks.text: Antivirus software aap ke computer ko spyware jaise harmful (nuqsan pohanchane wale) programs se bachata hai.

Misal: Jab aap internet se koi file download karte hain to antivirus software use chhupe hue khatron ke liye check karta hai. Agar file mehfooz ho to aap use befikri se khol sakte hain. Agar file harmful ho to software aap ko alert (khabardar) karta hai aur file ko nuqsan karne se rok deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Antivirus software ko update rakhna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Naye malware (nuqsan wale programs) har waqt bante rehte hain; update se antivirus ko naye khatron ki pehchan milti hai, warna woh naye khatre nahi pakar sakta.

items: Antivirus: download hui files check karta hai; harmful file par alert aur rok.
